title: fix(fields): a rich-content cell holding [] or {} says what it holds (objectui#8580)
body:
Fixes objectstack-ai/objectui#8580

## What

`MarkdownCellRenderer` and `HtmlCellRenderer` (`markdown`, `html`, `richtext`) tested the raw value and then `String()`'d it. Measured by rendering every registered field type against `[]`, `{}`, `''` and `null` through `getCellRenderer` on `7102b20d9` (DOM shapes written in words — tag-shaped fragments are eaten from GitHub bodies even inside backticks):

| field types | renderer | rendered for `[]` | rendered for `{}` |
|---|---|---|---|
| `markdown` | `MarkdownCellRenderer` | a childless DIV classed `prose` once settled; a childless SPAN classed `text-sm text-muted-foreground` while the lazy pipeline loads | a P reading `[object Object]` |
| `html`, `richtext` | `HtmlCellRenderer` | a childless DIV classed `prose` | the text `[object Object]` |

Both renderers now test the coerced text, as `TextCellRenderer` does (`richTextSource` in `richTextDisplay.tsx`). `coerceToSafeValue` moves into its own module (`packages/fields/src/coerceToSafeValue.ts`, docblock moved verbatim) so the display module the barrel imports can share it without importing the barrel back — the cycle objectui#5498 extracted that module to avoid. The barrel re-exports it unchanged (`dist/index.d.ts` carries the re-export after build; signature identical).

## Two defects, two rulings — decided separately

`@objectstack/spec` settles what these fields may hold: `STRING_VALUE_TYPES` in `packages/spec/src/data/field-value.zod.ts` lists `markdown`, `html`, `richtext` under "Value is a plain string", in the same class as `text` / `textarea` / `code`, and the write seam for that class is `z.string()` (line 496). Neither `[]` nor `{}` is a value of the class.

- **`[]` → the shared `EmptyValue`.** It holds no string and nothing to format; "No value" is true of it; this matches the twelve siblings the first two parts moved.
- **`{}` → NOT the affordance, and NOT `[object Object]`.** The record is storing something, so "No value" would be false. `[object Object]` is `String()`'s artefact and no sibling prints it. The string class already has one answer for an object — `coerceToSafeValue`: the display name when the object carries one, `[Object]` otherwise — so the three rich types now take that answer and format it, and the pin holds `{}` on each of them byte-equal to what `text` prints for `{}`. This is the class's existing convention applied to three members that had a private one, not a new renderer-side fallback (AGENTS.md #0.1): off-contract data stays visible, is not masked as "No value", and is not rendered as a coercion artefact.

Consequences declared: a one-entry array formats its one entry (the objectui#8490 email ruling, pinned); a `Date` now renders its ISO string rather than `Date.prototype.toString`'s locale text (the text-class answer); a whitespace-only string stays a string value (pinned as a boundary — trimming it into the affordance would be a second ruling, and `TextCellRenderer` does not trim either).

## The childless containers carried no affordance

Checked, as the card asked. `prose` (tailwind typography `DEFAULT`) sets `color`, `max-width` and font metrics — no padding, no border — and neither renderer binds a handler, so the container was inert: the objectui#8481 shape (nothing drawn where a placeholder belongs, no accessible name), not the live-anchor shape PR #8586 removed. The census instrument counted `a`, `button`, `role=checkbox`, `role=progressbar` and `tabindex` per cell: 0 for all three types at every value.

## Sanitisation: the populated branch did not move

`richTextSource` returns a string verbatim (`coerceToSafeValue` starts with the string identity branch), so the bytes reaching `sanitizeHtml` for a stored HTML value are the bytes that always did. Pinned on content, not on a count: `html` and `richtext` holding the hostile document (a script block, an inline `onerror`, a `javascript:` href) must render exactly the sanitiser's output string (a P reading ok, an IMG with src x, an A whose href is `#`, and nothing else) — and that pin passes on the UNFIXED tree too, so it pins the pre-existing path rather than a new one. `markdown` still drops raw HTML (the objectui#5452 pins are unchanged and green).

## Evidence — three legs, each mutation proven on disk in both directions with a line-total gate, restored by state

Runner: `leg.sh` (scratchpad) — `trap restore EXIT INT TERM`, absolute paths; restore is `git checkout HEAD -- PATH`, proven by `git diff HEAD` empty AND `git hash-object PATH` equal to `git rev-parse HEAD:PATH` (an empty hash is a failure); mutation gate = inserted-marker count, deleted-marker count, mutated hash differing from HEAD, and `wc -l` equal to the expected total. Harness-death signatures (`Cannot read properties of null`, `Unable to find`, `TypeError`, `is not a function`) were counted separately in every leg: **0** each time, so every red count below is assertions failing.

| leg | mutation (as proved) | pin file result | failure sentences observed |
|---|---|---|---|
| unfixed tree | `richTextDisplay.tsx` replaced by `git show BASE:path` — 212 → 162 lines, `richTextSource` ×0, `String(value)` ×3 | 9 failed / 9 passed | `[] must not render a childless container (the objectui#8481 shape)` ×3; `[object Object] is String()'s artefact, not a rendering` ×3; `must print what text prints for {}`; `an object with a name prints its name`; `markdown holding ['']: the shared EmptyValue affordance must be present`. The POPULATED block passes in full. |
| caricature — `EmptyValue` unconditionally | `const text = richTextSource(value)` → `undefined as string or undefined` ×2, 212 → 212 lines | 13 failed / 5 passed | every POPULATED case: `a populated value must still open its prose container` ×3, `a document must still open its prose container`, `the seed specimen must still render its bytes`, `a one-entry array formats its entry`; every `{}` case: `{} is not "No value" — the record is storing something` ×3, `must print what text prints for {}`, `an object with a name prints its name`; boundaries: `whitespace is a string value, not "No value"`, `a stored 0 still prints`. The 5 survivors are the affordance-present cases (`[]` ×3, `''`/`null`, `['']`) — the caricature's own scope, declared. |
| harness-kill — `data-slot="empty-value"` → `empty-value-killed` in `packages/components/src/custom/empty.tsx`, a file this PR does not touch | 184 → 184 lines, marker ×1 | 5 failed / 13 passed | `the shared EmptyValue affordance must be present` ×5 — textually distinct from the unfixed leg, and the defect-absence sentence passed first in every `[]` case, proving the assertion order. |

One assertion was caught passing on the caricature — the html/richtext same-bytes comparison compared `undefined` with `undefined` and only failed on its second sentence — and was strengthened (`ad1b363c0`, spelled as a boolean in `e7284acc6`); re-run against the caricature it fails on its own sentence.

## Census

53 registered types (50 literal `standardMap` keys + 3 spread from `RICH_TEXT_CELL_RENDERERS`) × 4 values = 212 cells, rendered through `getCellRenderer` with a 30 ms settle, sync and settled snapshots both recorded. Base `7102b20d9` → this branch before the merge: **6 moved**, exactly the card's six. Base → merged HEAD `e122a5e95` (after `origin/main` took PR #8586): **25 moved** = #8586's 19 + these 6, nothing else. On the merged tree the only `[]` rows whose output still differs from `null` are the objectui#8481 fence — `json`, `object`, `composite`, `record`, `location`, `geolocation`, `address` print the `[]` literal; `file`, `video`, `audio` say `0 files`. **No fourth part of this class remains.** The `{}` column is a different census and is handed to the PM in the report.

## Verification on merged HEAD `e122a5e95`

- `pnpm exec vitest run packages/fields/` plus the 12 consumer test files that render these three types (plugin-grid ×3, plugin-detail ×2, plugin-form, plugin-list ×3, app-shell ×2, console) — `Test Files 153 passed (153)`, `Tests 2556 passed (2556)`, `VERDICT command-exit 0`, held 3m41s.
- `pnpm --workspace-concurrency=2 --filter '@object-ui/fields^...' build` (closure, exit 0), then `pnpm --filter @object-ui/fields build && pnpm --filter @object-ui/fields type-check` — both programs (`tsc --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json`), `VERDICT command-exit 0`; type-check re-run on the merged tree, exit 0.
- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/fields lint` — 0 errors. The three `react-refresh/only-export-components` warnings on `richTextDisplay.tsx` pre-exist on BASE for the same three non-component exports; the two `no-explicit-any` warnings in the new pin are the same `as any` cast the objectui#8481 pin uses.
- Gates green on the merged tree: `check:esm-specifiers`, `check:unreferenced-sources`, `check:self-import`, `check:side-effects-array`, `check:phantom-deps`, `check:pre-install-import-graph`, `check:type-check-coverage`, `check:vi-mock-specifiers`, `check:vi-mock-inherit`, `check:control-bytes`, `check-changeset-presence`, `check-changeset-no-major`, `check-changeset-fixed`, `check-changeset-overwrite`; `check-governed-queue-guard --test` on all 21 changed paths: NOT GOVERNED.
- NOT MEASURED locally, declared to CI (prerequisite unmet, not a red): `check:readme-exports` (needs every package built — "27 unbuilt"), `check:eager-closure` (needs a console `vite build`).
- Narrowing declared: `turbo ls --affected` lists 20 packages; run locally = `fields` in full + the 12 consumer files above, found by `git grep` for the three type spellings across the other packages' tests. The barrel's exported surface is unchanged, so the remaining consumers' suites exercise unchanged code; they are CI's.
- Python zero-width / control-character scan of the five changed files, with a lit control: 0 hits.

## Merge with `origin/main`

PR #8586 landed while this was in flight (`21529629c`); merged with `git merge origin/main` (`e122a5e95`), no conflict — its `isBlankCellText` sits directly under the re-export block. objectui#8582 is not addressed here: its boolean renderer was reached by the census and reported, not edited.
